observations.title: Sangay volcano (Ecuador)
observations.description: The Instituto Geofísico-Escuela Politécnica Nacional (IG-EPN) reported that volcanic activity at Sangay continued during 4-11 November. The seismic network recorded 3-19 daily explosions, a few long-period earthquakes, a period of harmonic tremor, and 6-13 daily signals indicating emissions. On most days the Washington Volcanic Ash Advisory Center reported that ash-and-gas plumes were visible in webcam views and satellite images rising as high as 1.5 km above the crater rim and drifting mainly NW, W, and SW. During dark hours there were several episodes of incandescent material descending the flank as far as 500 m. Weather clouds sometimes prevented visual observations, especially during 8-10 November. The Secretaría de Gestión de Riesgos (SGR) maintained the Alert Level at Yellow (the second highest level on a four-color scale).
